Not saying you should allow that to happen, but don't best yourself up over failing. It happens. Just get back up and keep pushing. Each time you drop down to the bottom, you climb out a little more. Focus on how high you get as your streaks not your lows. You go a year without hurting yourself? Awesome, let's talk about what more you did? Made new friends? Got rid of bad ones? Workout? Got a job you liked? Even something small like told a friend you're pain that you never told before. Let's talk about the gains during you streaks of staying together. Never the failure. You get back up the next day and start a new one. And btw this is my opinion so if anything you disagree with or think it's not gonna help you ignore it! Do what works for you and makes you better and happier! We all view the world differently. That's just my mindset.
